revision_note: Thirteen connected new modules replace the old integral-only fraction-field route, rather than deleting its IsDomain assumptions. Actual restriction from an affine open to its principal intersection is the original away localization, obtained from the original scheme section map. Denominator clearing lifts each original cocycle row. Its descent error lies in the actual localization kernel on each double intersection; explicit finite powers kill every such error BEFORE any global contraction. Uniform finite maxima and a genuine unit-ideal partition then split the original cocycle by original local sections. This permits nilpotents, zero divisors, empty opens and the zero ring. Actual epimorphisms of arbitrary additive sheaves give finite principal local lifts; correcting them by this proved split and applying the original sheaf gluing proves global section lifting with the original structure sheaf kernel. Original open restriction and exact Ext sequences give actual local structure H'1 vanishing on every affine open of any scheme. Finally the unchanged finite projective dual-frame identity for every original affine line transfers this vanishing to that SAME line, and genuine open restriction/section lifting yields the original GLOBAL line's H'1 vanishing on every actual affine open. The middle and quotient sheaves in lifting are not required to be quasi-coherent. Nine existing producers from107r2 are copied exactly. No arbitrary cohomology carrier or vector-space structure is substituted. These are degree-one local acyclicity results, not a cohomology/base-change theorem, uniform family bound, relative divisor scheme or represented Jacobian. Hosted elaboration and recursive audit remain pending; no local Lean compilation and no baseline promotion.
